blurb: Guests can rent canoes, kayaks, and stand up paddle boards by the hour to explore Simpson Lake. The business offers paddle board lessons for kids, yoga and meditation classes on paddle boards, and guided wilderness kayak tours focusing on local wildlife and ecology. Classes and tours are led by experienced instructors and guides.
